description: Get decoded events emitted by a smart contract via TronGrid REST API. Returns a compact summary per event. Use a small limit and paginate with fingerprint to control response size

contract_address.description: TRON smart contract base58 address (starts with T)

event_name.description: Filter by specific event name (e.g. Transfer, Approval)

fingerprint.description: Pagination cursor from previous response meta.fingerprint — pass to fetch the next page

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-200, default 10). Start small to avoid large responses; use fingerprint to paginate for more

name: get_contract_events
